name: Metals & Mining: 6-Month Relative Strength vs SPY
description: Screens FCX, NEM, NUE, X, AA, CENX, CLF for 6-month (126-day) relative momentum vs SPY. Relative momentum = stock's 126d ROC minus SPY's 126d ROC. Positive = outperforming SPY, negative = lagging. Outputs: ranked bar chart showing current leaders/laggers, and a metrics table with absolute return, relative momentum, cross-sectional rank, and annualized volatility.
source:
# Metals & Mining: 6-Month Relative Strength vs SPY
# Universe: FCX, NEM, NUE, X, AA, CENX, CLF
# Signal: 126-day ROC (stock) minus 126-day ROC (SPY)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# SPY benchmark (shared context — same for all assets)
spy = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_close = ffill(spy.c)

# --- Compute ---
# 6-month (126 trading day) rate of change
stock_roc_126 = roc(period=126)(close)
spy_roc_126 = roc(period=126)(spy_close)

# Relative momentum: stock return minus SPY return (both in %)
rel_momentum = stock_roc_126 - spy_roc_126

# Cross-sectional rank (ascending=False → rank 1 = highest rel momentum)
cs_rank_val = cs_rank(ascending=False)(rel_momentum)

# Absolute 6-month return for context
abs_return = stock_roc_126

# Annualized volatility (20-day rolling, annualized)
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
vol_20d = volatility(period=20)(close)

# --- Output 1: Ranking Bar Chart ---
# "Who's Leading and Who's Lagging SPY?"
# Sorted descending, color by value (green = outperforming, red = underperforming)
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Who Is Leading vs Lagging SPY? (6-Month Relative Momentum)',
    category='Relative Strength',
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='SPY Benchmark')
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=rel_momentum)

# --- Output 2: Metrics Table ---
# Exact numbers: rank, relative momentum, absolute return, volatility
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Relative Strength Scorecard',
    category='Relative Strength',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Relative Strength Scorecard',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='CS Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rel Momentum vs SPY (6M)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Absolute 6M Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY 6M Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Volatility (20d)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(cs_rank_val, rel_momentum / 100, abs_return / 100, spy_roc_126 / 100, vol_20d)
